notes:
Fixes your own autorun scripts not running in your other cities. UPDATE AND THEN RELAUNCH YOUR BOTS - a bot reads its script when it starts, so a running bot keeps the old one.
In 1.36.3 the monitoring loop never finished in non-main cities, so anything you pasted in to run after it waited for a turn that never came. Only your main city keeps a loop running now, exactly as -mc 1 has always meant.
Updates now show up the moment they are released instead of up to five minutes later.
The Bots list column is now called Label, and separators can be given one too so a divider moves with the bots it belongs to.
